english:
Deals non-lethal damage based on <solar Scorch /> stacks. Damage starts after 0.5 seconds and ticks every 0.56 seconds, except for a 0.93 second delay before the second tick.

Reaching 100 stacks removes all <solar Scorch /> and triggers an <solar Ignition />.

Each tick's damage is given as 2.7 + (0.175 × <solar Scorch /> stacks). Non-<link Boss [#CombatantClassifications] /> Combatants take 20% increased damage. Reaching at least 60 stacks increases damage by 2.5%, indicated by yellow damage numbers.

Duration and decay rate depend on difficulty. The source lists a 2.3 second duration before losing 1 stack every 0.04 seconds (25 stacks per second).

// Source examples give 3|5|6.5|7.21|8.64 damage per tick at 1|30|50|60|80 stacks, which do not match the formula. The sandbox for the formula and examples, the scope of the 2.5% increase, and the difficulty of the decay values are unspecified.

source.text:
Scorched Enemies are dealt Scorch-stack based damage every 0.56 seconds after being scorched for 0.5 seconds. 
All Scorch is removed upon reaching x100 Scorch to trigger an Ignition.
The 2nd Scorch tick has a 0.93s delay for some reason.

Scorch Stack Damage Scaling per Tick:
2.7 + (0.175 * Scorch Stacks) | Non-Boss Combatants receive 20% increased damage.
 x1 = 3 | x30 = 5 | x50 = 6.5 | x60 = 7.21 | x80 = 8.64 | Scorch Damage is non-lethal.
Deals 2.5% increased damage upon reaching at least x60 Scorch, indicated by Yellow Damage Numbers.

Scorch Decay:
Scorch duration and decay rate is difficulty-dependent. 
 Scorch lasts for 2.3 seconds, then decreases by x1 stacks every 0.04 seconds (-25/s)
